name: Niagara Escarpment

geo.extent: Niagara River to the Bruce Peninsula and Manitoulin Island

description: The cuesta that splits the West Lowland of southern Ontario, running from the Niagara River on a sinuous westerly and north-westerly course to the Bruce Peninsula and Manitoulin Island; it reaches 535 m at 44°23′N 80°14′W. The main ridge of cliffs, forest and hiking terrain within reach of the Toronto–Hamilton region.
